_comment: Durable Amazon ASIN registry, keyed by card_id. build_site.py merges these into pricing.amazon_asin at build time so they survive aggregator rebuilds (which regenerate data/cards/*.json without ASINs). Each ASIN verified live against amazon.com before entry. When a card's ASIN changes, update HERE, not in the card JSON (that gets overwritten). The 'absent' list is the inverse verdict: card_ids VERIFIED not sold on Amazon (new or at all) — build_site skips every Amazon rung for these (straight to the eBay chain), because a close-match Amazon page for an absent product is the e930bea wrong-product trap.
